text_block_list.text:
Summer is here, and with the Kikuka Sho

approaching, we have our work cut out
for us. As
the bus sets off for summer
camp, we seem to be
travelling in an
auspicious direction.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару delights in her good

fortune—until the bus overshoots good
fortune
and heads toward misfortune.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Expecting all sorts of hardships at camp,

Matikanefukukitaru falls into despair.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
